states.expect: render exact numeric badge 0-state (present means known; empty member server is also present-0, never absent)
render exact numeric badge 3; never substitute broader unreadCount
the ONE set-based batch query failed → HTTP 200, every entry keeps legacy fields, activityUnreadCount absent on ALL entries (single failure domain; no pretended per-server isolation)
entry absent entirely → same unknown fallback as an absent field; clients must not render a third state

mixed state arises ONLY from provable per-server causes (per-group validation failure, permission loss, feature gate) — never from a pretended isolatable per-server SQL compute failure; unknown entries render the §3a transitional fallback (legacy broader number) until production serves the field, then dot/hidden

muteRule: serverPushMuted never alters activityUnreadCount; muted servers show the exact number (weakened style allowed). For absent/unknown see renderRule.
renderRule: v2.4.6 §3a transitional: present ⇒ render that exact number (present 0 renders nothing); absent/unknown ⇒ render the legacy broader unread NUMBER (pre-#2119 behavior), NOT a dot — artin ruling 2026-08-17 while production lacks the field. The wire rule is unchanged: absent stays absent and this field is never populated from the broader count. After production promotion the fallback branch is dead code and absent returns to dot/hidden; the rendered number then becomes the exact Activity count and MAY GET SMALLER, which is expected, not a regression.
freshness: count may lag ≤30s; Activity snapshot is the reconciliation authority on server entry
